format: MCPB manifest 0.3, standard pinned mcpb packager
rules: Bundle identity and revision are distinct from Head runtime version and recipient place name
A bundle carries the selected public source package and composition plus a verified complete runtime closure and licenses
No install-time dependency fetch or arbitrary host node_modules copy
No sender keys, credentials, grants, answers, private state, environment or personal paths
An internal digest is integrity data, not sender authentication
Recipient consent uses the existing connect flow; installing carries no action authority
No new verb, provider catalogue, ZIP implementation or alternate compiler
The target remains the verified platform of the runtime, currently macOS
The standard packager vector verifies packaging mechanics only, not real Desktop installation or final runtime acceptance
pending: Native admission and final installed release acceptance
scope: Composition of interpreted API documents and configured Streamable HTTP MCP catalogues. Receiving configuration does not copy a remote server implementation or its credentials.
